fact: A two-headed stone giant bursts into the district plaza, howling with wild-eyed madness.
source_quote: A two-headed stone giant, gray-skinned and howling with wild-eyed madness, burst through one of the district's gates
subject: two-headed stone giant

fact: The two-headed stone giant smashes through one of the district's gates.
source_quote: burst through one of the district's gates
subject: gate breach

fact: The two-headed stone giant kills a duergar soldier, sending the body flying near the party.
source_quote: A duergar soldier's broken body flew through the air and crashed near the party's feet
subject: duergar soldier killed

fact: The duergar soldier is dead, killed by the two-headed stone giant.
source_quote: A duergar soldier's broken body flew through the air and crashed near the party's feet
subject: duergar soldier

fact: Thorin identifies the stone giant's violent behavior as abnormal given the species' taciturn nature.
source_quote: Thorin recognized immediately that this was deeply wrong. Stone giants were among the most taciturn and reserved creatures in existence
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum raises and brandishes his holy symbol at the approaching stone giant.
source_quote: Gyrgum raised his holy symbol and brandished it at the giant
subject: Gyrgum brandishes holy symbol

fact: Daz casts Magic Missile, striking the stone giant for 15 damage.
source_quote: Daz unleashed a volley of magical force that struck the giant unerringly... Magic Missile deals 15 damage
subject: Daz casts Magic Missile

fact: Zalthir conjures a sphere of magical darkness that blinds the stone giant.
source_quote: conjured a sphere of magical darkness that swallowed the giant whole, blinding the massive creature
subject: Zalthir casts Darkness

fact: Thorin attacks the blind stone giant with his short sword for 6 damage.
source_quote: Thorin exploited the giant's blindness to drive his blade home... deals 6 damage
subject: Thorin attacks giant

fact: Gyrgum channels radiant energy through his holy symbol, dealing 11 radiant damage to the stone giant.
source_quote: Gyrgum channeled searing radiant energy through his holy symbol... takes 11 radiant damage
subject: Gyrgum casts radiant energy

fact: The stone giant blindly attacks Thorin, rolling a 25 for 10 bludgeoning damage.
source_quote: The creature lashed out blindly at Thorin and connected... rolls a 25 (+9) for 10 bludgeoning damage
subject: Giant attacks Thorin

fact: Zalthir deflects the stone giant's blow, reducing the damage to zero.
source_quote: Zalthir deflected the blow with practiced precision... no damage is taken
subject: Zalthir deflects blow

fact: A squad of duergar city guards arrives at the plaza to join the battle.
source_quote: a squad of duergar city guards came rushing into the plaza, weapons drawn, ready to join the fray
subject: duergar city guards

fact: Daz repositions and hits the stone giant with Magic Missile for 9 damage.
source_quote: Daz moves to see around the darkness and hits with Magic Missile for 9
subject: Daz casts Magic Missile (second)

fact: Zalthir attacks the stone giant, dealing 11 damage and following up with a focus-point attack.

subject: Zalthir attacks giant

fact: Gyrgum moves around the darkness and hits the stone giant with a crossbow bolt for 9 damage.
source_quote: Gyrgum moves around the darkness and hits with a crossbow bolt (17) for 9
subject: Gyrgum shoots crossbow
